description: This file defines the class ModuleRequiredByThemesUninstallValidator, which ensures that modules cannot be uninstalled if enabled themes depend on them. It includes methods for validating module dependencies and configuration import scenarios within Drupal.

classes.name: ModuleRequiredByThemesUninstallValidator
classes.description: A validator class that prevents uninstallation of modules if themes depend on them, and checks dependencies during configuration import.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with translation and extension list services.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if themes depend on a given module, returning reasons if dependencies exist.

methods.name: validateConfigImport
methods.description: Checks if themes depending on a module will still be dependent after a configuration import, returning reasons if so.

methods.name: getThemesDependingOnModule
methods.description: Returns a list of themes that depend on a specified module.
